Why this guide is different

This whitepaper describes only capabilities that exist and are in real use in Virtual Marketer today — no roadmap, no announcement. Every example and mechanism (such as the “read-back” step before anything is sent) is taken verbatim from the actual product interface.

It deliberately contains no invented statistics, studies or case numbers. Where a claim couldn't be substantiated, it was phrased qualitatively instead, or left out entirely — even where a made-up percentage would have sounded more impressive.
